corners.name: Original corners
corners.description: The familiar L brackets. A clean reference for every comparison.

rails.name: Light rails
rails.description: Long, fine tracks with small index ticks. Precise and architectural.

bevel.name: Prism cut
bevel.description: Chamfered corners with two illuminated edges. A more sculpted frame.

echo.name: Double exposure
echo.description: Offset corner traces in two tones. A restrained phosphor afterimage.

arc.name: Orbital arcs
arc.description: Open arcs and four quiet alignment ticks. Softer, spacious geometry.

rails-ii.name: Light rails II
rails-ii.description: Twin light tracks, cut joints and brighter end caps. A more deliberate silhouette.

still.name: Immediate
still.description: No entrance effect. The reference for speed and clarity.

sweep.name: Light sweep
sweep.description: A single light line travels down as the image appears. 620 ms.

aperture.name: Split aperture
aperture.description: A diagonal opening expands from the centre. 540 ms.

develop.name: Phosphor develop
develop.description: Soft light resolves into a crisp photograph. 480 ms.

raster.name: Raster build
raster.description: Twelve measured steps reveal the image like a plotter. 600 ms.

pixel.name: Pixel reconstruction
pixel.description: Large, crisp blocks build into a detailed image. A one-second transmission.

print.name: Screen-print reveal
print.description: Poster inks, halftone dots and a diagonal print pass. 1.2 seconds.

spectral.name: Spectral split
spectral.description: Cyan and violet image layers converge into one photograph. 960 ms.

blueprint.name: Blueprint exposure
blueprint.description: A cyan image develops through a luminous drafting grid. 1.05 seconds.

broadcast.name: Broadcast assembly
broadcast.description: Wide image bands arrive from opposite sides and lock together. 1.1 seconds.

relay.name: Ion / Relay
relay.description: Your Ion palette, precise light rails and one clean scan. The strongest starting point.

aperture.name: Prism / Aperture
aperture.description: Faceted light, cut corners and a diagonal reveal. Sharper and more cinematic.

ghost.name: Ion / Ghost
ghost.description: A wider corridor, softer glow and a double trace. More analogue, less insistent.

observatory.name: Orbit / Observatory
observatory.description: Broad silver arcs and quiet image frames. The most restrained of the new mixes.

film.name: Dusk / Film
film.description: Rose light, coarser background texture and an offset frame. A warmer alternative.

plot.name: Blueprint / Plot
plot.description: Drafting lines, indexed rails and a stepped reveal. The most instrument-like direction.

transmission.name: Light Grid / Transmission
transmission.description: Rebuilt Light Rails, a cobalt portrait and chunky pixels resolving into focus.

imprint.name: Light Grid / Imprint
imprint.description: The Light Grid you loved, with four poster inks, a diagonal print pass and the new rails.

refraction.name: Light Grid / Refraction
refraction.description: Violet and cyan exposures converge inside the new frame, against your chosen Light Grid.

exposure.name: Light Grid / Exposure
exposure.description: A cyanotype portrait develops through a drafting grid, bounded by twin light tracks.

broadcast.name: Light Grid / Broadcast
broadcast.description: Copper image bands assemble inside the new rails. A warm print against the cool Light Grid.

lightline.name: Light Grid / Signal
lightline.description: Your latest vote: Light Grid, the original Light Rails and Light Sweep. The reference for this round.

natural.name: Original colour
natural.description: The photograph as it was captured.

cobalt.name: Cobalt duotone
cobalt.description: Deep navy, cyan midtones and cool paper highlights.

prism.name: Prism spectrum
prism.description: Ink shadows, violet midtones and a pale cyan finish.

press.name: Poster inks
press.description: Four bold ink levels from your LinkedIn palette. A graphic, poster-like portrait.

amber.name: Copper print
amber.description: Indigo shadows, warm copper and creamy highlights.
